title: Awakening
premise: A small creature wakes in an unfamiliar place and begins to look around.

shots.purpose: Establish the sleeping character and location before movement.
shots.visual: A small creature sleeps on a central pedestal in an ancient open-air ruin.
shots.storyboard_prompt: Cinematic 3D storyboard frame. A small creature sleeps quietly on a central pedestal in an ancient open-air ruin. Wide enough to establish scale and surrounding architecture. No glow or active energy.

shots.purpose: Show the first moment of consciousness.
shots.visual: The creature slowly opens its eyes and slightly lifts its head while remaining on the pedestal.
shots.start_frame_prompt: Exact starting frame: the creature remains asleep on the pedestal, motionless except for subtle breathing. Preserve the established composition and scale.
shots.end_frame_prompt: Exact destination frame: the creature is awake with eyes open and head slightly raised, still on the pedestal. Preserve the same architecture, scale, camera direction, anatomy, and lighting.
shots.video_prompt: The creature slowly opens its eyes, pauses, then slightly lifts its head. Keep the movement small and natural. No jumping, turning, locomotion, architecture changes, or new objects.
